checks.label: Boot Mode Status
checks.description: Device boot mode - fastboot/recovery/charger modes allow partition modification
checks.remediation: Reboot the device normally. If stuck in recovery or fastboot, investigate the cause before rebooting.

checks.label: vbmeta Device State
checks.description: vbmeta device_state must be locked
checks.remediation: Re-lock the bootloader via 'fastboot flashing lock' after flashing stock firmware.

checks.label: AVB Version Present
checks.description: AVB version should be present
checks.remediation: Ensure the device firmware includes AVB support. Flash a firmware build that ships with vbmeta.

checks.label: avbctl Present
checks.command: command -v avbctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo present || echo absent
checks.description: avbctl binary available for rollback checks
checks.remediation: Install or restore the avbctl binary from the vendor partition or OEM system image.

checks.label: Rollback Index (slot 0) > 0
checks.command: command -v avbctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && avbctl get-rollback-index 0 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $NF}' || echo 0
checks.description: Anti-rollback index should be > 0 (slot 0) (INFO if avbctl unavailable)
checks.remediation: Apply the latest OTA update to advance the rollback index. Ensure avbctl is available on the device.

checks.label: Rollback Index (slot 1) > 0
checks.command: command -v avbctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && avbctl get-rollback-index 1 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $NF}' || echo 0
checks.description: Anti-rollback index should be > 0 (slot 1) (INFO if avbctl unavailable)
checks.remediation: Apply the latest OTA update to advance the rollback index. Ensure avbctl is available on the device.

checks.label: OEM Unlock Allowed
checks.description: Should be disabled to prevent unlock
checks.remediation: Disable OEM unlocking in Settings > Developer Options > OEM Unlocking.

checks.label: Safe Mode
checks.description: Should not be running in Safe Mode
checks.remediation: Reboot the device normally to exit Safe Mode.

checks.label: FRP Policy
checks.description: Factory Reset Protection should be enabled
checks.remediation: Add a Google account and enable FRP via device policy or MDM to protect against unauthorized resets.

checks.label: ADB Over Wi-Fi
checks.description: Risky if enabled
checks.remediation: Disable wireless debugging in Settings > Developer Options > Wireless Debugging.

checks.label: Bootloader Locked
checks.description: 1 means locked bootloader; 0 means unlocked
checks.remediation: Re-lock the bootloader via 'fastboot flashing lock' after restoring stock firmware.

checks.label: Fastboot Unlock Allowed
checks.description: Fastboot OEM unlock must be disabled
checks.remediation: Disable OEM unlocking in Developer Options and verify the carrier or OEM policy disallows it.

checks.label: OEM Unlock Disabled (Global Setting)
checks.description: OEM unlock should be disallowed by policy (0)
checks.remediation: Set 'settings put global oem_unlock_allowed 0' or disable OEM unlocking in Developer Options.

checks.label: FRP Partition Path Set
checks.description: Factory Reset Protection partition path configured
checks.remediation: Ensure the device tree defines ro.frp.pst pointing to the persistent storage partition for FRP.

checks.label: Verity Mode (cmdline)
checks.description: dm-verity should be enforcing
checks.remediation: Flash stock vbmeta without the --disable-verity flag to re-enable dm-verity enforcement.

checks.label: dm-verity-backed Partitions Mounted
checks.description: At least one partition should be backed by dm-verity
checks.remediation: Reflash stock firmware and vbmeta to restore dm-verity-backed partition mounts.

checks.label: AVB/Verity Success in dmesg
checks.description: Kernel logs should show AVB/verity success (if accessible)
checks.remediation: Verify dmesg access permissions. Reflash stock images if AVB/verity messages are absent.

checks.label: Test-keys Build
checks.description: Test-keys in fingerprint indicates insecure engineering/debug build
checks.remediation: Flash an official release-signed firmware build from the OEM. Do not use test-keys builds in production.

checks.label: Boot Image Tampered
checks.description: Check for unusual file sizes or dates
checks.remediation: Compare /init and /init.rc sizes and timestamps against known-good stock images for anomalies.

checks.label: System Partition Tampering
checks.description: Detects immutability or possible tampering
checks.remediation: Reflash the stock system image if unexpected attributes are found on app_process binaries.
